items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-vinyl-greenhouse
reasons: view34 pass: tunnel roof seen from above rows 0-80 (long foreshortened hoop plane, front-edge at the arch line row ~80); south end face is the full-width arch rows 80-108 with door; no receding side plane (edges symmetric)
style pass: tinted dark grey-blue outline like jp-warehouse, film shaded in 4+ greys; reads as a hoop house at 1x in maps/04

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-hillside-torii-stairs
reasons: view34 pass: kasagi roof top rows 1-6 seen from above, same depth as jp-torii anchor; each stair tread drawn as a light top band with a dark riser (rows 24-78), landing rows 22-30; stone lantern kasa rows 48-53 shows a lit top
style pass: tinted outlines, stone in 4+ tones; reads at 1x on the wall in maps/06

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-retro-postbox-vending
reasons: kind: a postbox + vending machine is not a building/gate; judged as box (min top 4, front 8)

view34 pass: vending top plane rows 8-16 (8 rows) with front face rows 17-31; round postbox shows a lighter cap rows 9-16 over the red body rows 17-31; right 1-2px darker column is shading, not a side plane
style pass: tinted dark outlines; reads at 1x in maps/02
fixes: none required; optionally relabel kind as box/other in the manifest

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-unmanned-veg-stand

style pass: wood in 4+ browns, tinted brown outline; reads at 1x in maps/01,02,06

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-fire-watchtower
reasons: view34 pass: pyramid roof seen from above rows 1-18; cabin rows 19-28 under eave; 4-leg lattice with rear footings rows 41-47 and front footings rows 59-63 (correct depth staggering, no isometric side face)
style pass: red steel in 4 tones with dark-red outline; reads as a hinomi-yagura at 1x in maps/04

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-jizo-shrine-row
reasons: view34 pass: hokora roof seen from above rows 0-23 ending in eave line rows 21-24; stone plinth top rows 36-38 (3 rows, meets structure/figure min 3) with front face rows 39-44
style pass: same tinted-outline wood/stone treatment as jp-jizo; reads at 1x in maps/06

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-sluice-gate
reasons: view34 pass: concrete deck/hoist beam top rows 0-11 with handwheel as a horizontal ellipse rows 1-3 (seen from above); front: piers and gate leaf rows 12-21, water rows 22-31
style pass: grey concrete 4+ tones, tinted outline; reads at 1x in the canal in maps/04

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-red-iron-bridge
reasons: view34 pass: deck seen from above rows 15-27 between far railing (rows 2-14, south face) and near railing (top rail rows 28-30 lit top, posts to row 37); girder front face rows 38-45 with stone abutments
style pass: red in 4 tones with dark-red outline; reads at 1x on the road over the river in maps/05

summary: 8/8 pass. All show top planes from above at or above anchor depth (roofs, deck, kasagi, plinth) with south faces below; no front-elevation, side-face or sticker-outline charges. Only note: retro-postbox-vending is mislabeled structure (closest kind box), which does not fail by itself.
